name: Validate SurrealDB Container
description: Validate SurrealDB Docker container configuration (service health, connectivity, database operations)

task_steps.description: Check SurrealDB container status (running, healthy, uptime)

prompt.template:
Check the Docker container status for SurrealDB:

1. Run: docker ps --filter name=surrealdb --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.State}}'
2. Check logs: docker logs surrealdb --tail 30
3. Report:
   - Container state (running/stopped)
   - Health status
   - Uptime duration
   - Recent log entries
   - Any startup errors

Provide a clear status summary.

task_steps.description: Verify SurrealDB server is running and responding

prompt.template:
Verify SurrealDB server is operational:

1. Check process: docker exec surrealdb ps aux | grep surreal
2. Check port: docker exec surrealdb netstat -tuln | grep 8000 || ss -tuln | grep 8000
3. Test HTTP endpoint: curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || curl -f http://localhost:8000/status || echo "HTTP endpoint failed"
4. Report:
   - Server process status
   - Port 8000 binding status
   - HTTP endpoint response
   - Any errors

Provide SurrealDB server verification summary.

task_steps.description: Verify SurrealDB network accessibility from other containers

prompt.template:
Verify network connectivity to SurrealDB:

1. Check Docker network: docker network inspect metabob-network | grep surrealdb
2. Test from API server: docker exec api-server ping -c 2 surrealdb || echo "SurrealDB unreachable from API"
3. Test port: docker exec api-server nc -zv surrealdb 8000 || echo "Port 8000 unreachable"
4. Report:
   - Network name
   - Accessibility from API server
   - Port 8000 status
   - Any network issues

Provide network connectivity summary.

Test SurrealDB database operations:

1. Try SQL query via HTTP API:
   curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/sql \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"sql": "INFO FOR DB;"}' || echo "SQL query failed"

2. Check if we can access via surreal CLI:
   docker exec surrealdb surreal version || echo "CLI not available"

3. Report:
   - SQL query status
   - CLI availability
   - Response format
   - Any errors

Provide database operations test summary.

Check SurrealDB configuration:

1. Check environment: docker exec surrealdb env | grep -i surreal
2. Check command: docker inspect surrealdb --format '{{.Config.Cmd}}'
3. Check volumes: docker inspect surrealdb --format '{{.Mounts}}'
4. Report:
   - Database path/namespace
   - Authentication settings
   - Persistent storage (volume mounts)
   - Any configuration warnings

Provide SurrealDB configuration summary.

Generate validation report for SurrealDB container:

Summarize all validation results:
1. Container Status: [running/stopped, healthy/unhealthy]
2. SurrealDB Server: [process status, port binding]
3. Network Connectivity: [accessible/unreachable from API]
4. Database Operations: [SQL query status, CLI availability]
5. Configuration: [namespace, auth, storage]

Overall Assessment:
- ✅ PASS: All checks successful
- ⚠️ WARNING: Minor issues found
- ❌ FAIL: Critical issues found

Recommendations:
- List any required fixes
- Suggest improvements

Create report file: test-results/surrealdb-container-validation.md
